summary: replace options: after and before to limit the region (DOTALL, not MULTILINE), attributes, backup, and encoding.
questions: How do I only replace text after a certain line?
How do I limit replacements to a section between two markers?
Why does ^ in after only match the start of the file?
How do I back up before replacing?

answer_card.title: replace before/after region
answer_card.answer_md:
- `after` / `before`: only touch content after/before the match. Use DOTALL (`.` matches newlines) and **not** MULTILINE, so `^`/`$` mean file start/end; add `(?m)` to change.
- `backup` (false), `encoding` (utf-8), `attributes`
